documents.text: Saturn has 146 confirmed moons, making it the planet with the most moons in our solar system.
There are over 140 moons orbiting Saturn, including the large moon Titan.

runs.answer: Saturn has 146 confirmed moons, the most of any planet in the solar system.
Based on the documents, Saturn has over 140 moons, with 146 confirmed.
